name: com.tencent.ysdk.module.user.impl.freelogin.FreeLoginInfoActivity
description: Tencent YSDK opens this Activity when a free-login handoff returns login information; it saves that information and reports success or failure to the caller.
disableEffect: Tencent YSDK's free-login handoff will fail, so players may be unable to sign in through that path.
